Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_07079_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_07079_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_07079 (
	input  CLOCK,
	input  [23:0] I2C_DATA,	
	input  GO,
	input  RESET,	
	input  W_R,
 	inout  I2C_SDAT,	
	output I2C_SCLK,
	output END,	
	output ACK
);

reg END_OK, ACK_OK;
reg [2:0] state;
reg SDAO;
reg [7:0] SLAVE_ADDRESS;
reg [15:0] REG_DATA;
reg [2:0] bit_index;
reg scl_reg;
reg [7:0] data_byte;

// I2C Output Assignments
assign I2C_SDAT = SDAO ? 1'bz : 1'b0;
assign I2C_SCLK = scl_reg;

// State Machine
always @(posedge CLOCK or posedge RESET) begin
	if (RESET) begin
		state <= 3'b000;
		END_OK <= 1'b0;
		ACK_OK <= 1'b0;
		SDAO <= 1'b1;
		scl_reg <= 1'b1;
		bit_index <= 3'b000;
		SLAVE_ADDRESS <= 8'h00;
		REG_DATA <= 16'h0000;
		data_byte <= 8'h00;
	end else begin
		case (state)
			3'b000: begin // Initialization State
				if (GO) begin
					state <= 3'b001;
					SLAVE_ADDRESS <= I2C_DATA[23:16];
					REG_DATA <= I2C_DATA[15:0];
				end
			end
			3'b001: begin // Start Condition
				// Code to generate the start condition
				SDAO <= 1'b0;
				state <= 3'b010;
			end
			3'b010: begin // Send Slave Address
				// Code to send slave address
				if (bit_index < 3'b111) begin
					bit_index <= bit_index + 1'b1;
				end else begin
					state <= 3'b011;
					bit_index <= 3'b000;
				end
			end
			3'b011: begin // Send Register Data
				// Code to send register data
				if (bit_index < 3'b111) begin
					bit_index <= bit_index + 1'b1;
				end else begin
					state <= 3'b100;
					bit_index <= 3'b000;
				end
			end
			3'b100: begin // Stop Condition
				// Code to generate the stop condition
				SDAO <= 1'b1;
				state <= 3'b000;
				END_OK <= 1'b1;  // Transaction complete
			end
		endcase
	end
end

assign END = END_OK;
assign ACK = ACK_OK;

endmodule
